work.name: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
work.summary: Development of Generative Models for Photocatalyst Discovery under Prof. Mikiya Fujii. Focus on discovering novel powder-type semiconductor photocatalyst materials with desirable properties.

work.name: Nanyang Technological University
work.summary: Development of Generative Models for Inorganic Material Crystal Structure under Assoc. Prof. Kedar Hippalgaonkar. Focus on proposing novel crystal structures considering symmetry and thermodynamic stability.

work.name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology
work.summary: Large language models for automatic extraction of data from scientific literature under T.T.-Prof. Pascal Friederich. Work included deploying and fine-tuning pretrained LLMs.

work.name: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
work.summary: Multi-Objective Generative Adversarial Networks for Inorganic Chemical Compositions under Prof. Mikiya Fujii. Verified accuracy using DFT calculations and CSPML ML model for crystal structure prediction.

work.name: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
work.summary: Drug Molecule Generation with Variational Auto Encoder under Prof. Mikiya Fujii. Focus on generating novel drug molecules through gradient-based exploration of VAE latent space.

work.name: Doshisha University
work.summary: The Effects of Auditory Stimulation on Episodic Memory using fNIRS under Prof. Hiroyasu Tomoyuki. Investigated relationship between music and long-term memory.
